t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Green, blue, orange, yellow are one basket.  The other colours are the other basket.  Do one basket until the scores reduce then switch to the other.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes wearing green, blue, orange and yellow caps correspond to one colour of basket in the woods.  The other coloured caps will take you to a different basket.  Stick with one of these groups and when you notice that your scores start to reduce in value move to the other group.  You will need to keep changing groups to score as high as possible always moving to the basket with the higher scores.  At times both groups will provide only low scores, keep swapping until you hit on higher scores again.
